description: BLUE coalition unit configuration rules - frequency, COM channels and settings

categories.name: BLUE Aircraft Configuration
categories.description: BLUE coalition unit configurations for air superiority

rules.name: BLUE Client Type Required
rules.description: All BLUE player aircraft must be set as Client type

rules.name: BLUE COMM Channels Set (Aircraft Only)
rules.description: Client-controlled BLUE aircraft units must have UHF/VHF radios configured
exceptions: AI-controlled ground units don't need COMM channels
Static ground units are not valid targets for this rule

rules.name: CAP Frequency Standard
rules.description: CAP aircraft should use standard surveillance frequency 485 MHz

rules.name: SEAD Frequency Standard
rules.description: SEAD aircraft should use standard frequency 251 MHz

rules.name: Rotary Frequency Standard
rules.description: Helicopter COM frequencies should be in rotary band 30 FM

rules.name: F-14 INS Configuration Verified
rules.description: F-14s should have valid INS configuration enabled on cold starts
